lines.text: He's dressed to impress for the interview.

data.define: Wearing fancy clothes to make a good impression.

example.text: He's dressed to impress for the interview.

misuse.text: Don't say 'dressed to impress' about pajamas.
misuse.why: It means a smart, planned outfit.

data.l1: arrasando no visual; vestido pra causar
data.l1_hook: Dia de entrevista. Terno e gravata! "dressed to impress"
data.l1_ex: Ele está "dressed to impress" para a entrevista.
